name: The grammar
owner: abp.sgit.ai, promoted from what-can-it-do.games.sgit.ai and bridged back to it
status_note: Complete for what it is: 10 verbs, 9 object classes, 5 reach classes, 9 families, 3 undo classes, 23 primitives, 33 word nodes with their own addresses. Nothing is added to it by the map except one property, material, and that is deliberate: the grammar is the shared layer that everybody reads by address and nobody forks, so it has to stay small.

node_types.name: Verb
node_types.formula: [Verb] := a node that is the -verb_of-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: ObjectClass
node_types.formula: [ObjectClass] := a node that is -acted_on_by-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: ReachClass
node_types.formula: [ReachClass] := a node that is -reachable_from-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: Family
node_types.formula: [Family] := a node that is the -family_of-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: UndoClass
node_types.formula: a node that is the -undo_class_of-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: Capability
node_types.formula: [Capability] := a node with a -has_verb-> [Verb] and an -acts_on-> [ObjectClass] and a -reaches-> [ReachClass]
node_types.note: Gains one property, material, with the values own, organisation, third_party and mixed: whose material a capability reaches. A property, never a fourth element of the grammar. The default lives here; the override lives on the mandate in U5.

verbs.reads_as: this capability has the verb read
verbs.inverse_reads_as: read is the verb of these capabilities
files are acted on by these capabilities

verbs.reads_as: this capability reaches this reach class
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this reach class is reachable from this capability

verbs.reads_as: this capability is in the filesystem family
verbs.inverse_reads_as: the filesystem family is the family of these capabilities

verbs.reads_as: this capability has the undo class no
verbs.inverse_reads_as: undo class no is the undo class of these capabilities

verbs.reads_as: our node is similar to their node

adds: Two verbs in it, receive and revoke, have nothing under them and are kept as named absences. The grammar is the fixed point of the whole map: what every other universe attaches to by address, and what none of them may change.

provenance.note: The universe is authored in admin/build/universes.py; the matched counts and the live junctions are computed from the graph on every build.
